stage1.impression: A dark, red-brown tunnel. The oak jambs of the porch fill more than half the frame, and at the end of it two speakers glow like red neon signs either side of a multicoloured neon gyroscope. Two smooth capsule mannequins sit in plain chairs, and a hard spotlight ellipse lands on an empty floor. The finish is clean, but it reads as a game level or a showroom render, not a night photograph of a specific bar. A magazine would not run it: it shows almost none of the place, so it reads as a generic dark room with a light-sculpture gimmick.

blocking_9: The frame must show the place the card describes: the bar or quartzite counter in the foreground, the lantern's slotted oak face and the lit amber band around the porch opening, with the room seen through the porch. Today the porch jambs (x 0-310 and 855-1200, about 55% of the frame) are flat dark walls at lum_median 10.
Frame lum_median between 22 and 50 (now 11.4), with the speakers at 45 or more (now 16).
A neutral grade: the whole frame is r 26 / g 8 / b 2 at its median, so oak, plaster and terrazzo all read as one saturated red-orange instead of warm neutrals.
Believable people: the two figures are smooth capsule mannequins with no clothing, hair or real motion blur.
The Tropos covers must read as thick cast acrylic with glowing polished edges, not as flat red light boxes (the front-cover edges clip 4% at r 117 / g 7 / b 2).
The light must land on things: Mother's spot pool falls on the bare floor in front of her plinth, and the plinth and speaker stands sit at lum_median 5-10.
Real material detail at 1:1: oak grain, terrazzo chips and plaster texture are invisible in the crush, and the ceiling reads as a uniform fine CG texture.

defects.what: The left porch jamb is a featureless dark oak slab filling a quarter of the frame (lum_median 10, crush 19%).
The right porch jamb is a featureless dark slab (lum_median 10.5); no doors, hardware, band or edge light shows that this is a porch.
A heavy red-orange cast: median RGB 26/8/2, and the blue channel is almost empty everywhere.
The left Tropos reads as a red neon light box; its cover edges clip (4.3%) and it shows no thickness or reflection, so it reads as signage. Speaker lum_median 16.
The right Tropos has the same light-box look; lum_median 16, clip 1.3%.
Mother EARF's blue, green and yellow rings add saturated colours beside the Ember pair, and the frame no longer has one colour.
Mother's spot draws a hard elliptical pool on the empty floor in front of the plinth (lum_median 49) instead of lighting her or her plinth.
The seated figure is a smooth capsule mannequin (head, torso and arm blobs) with no blur; it reads as a placeholder.
Empty chairs with crude slab backs and thin rod frames, on a floor with no visible terrazzo (lum_median 13).
One downlight scallop at the top of the slatted wall falls from 174 to 15 within the top half, and the lower wall dies into darkness.
The ceiling has a uniform, repeating fine texture that reads as CG; two faint light streaks hang at x 400 and 690.
Mother's plinth is dark (lum_median 10.5); the terrazzo chips are barely legible.
The floor is flat and dark (lum_median 12.9), with no reflection, texture or sign of life (no glass, no record, no coat).

changes.problem: The frame is the inside of the porch, not the view from the bar into the lantern, so neither the architecture nor the bar is shown.

evidence.measured: The jambs fill x 0-310 and 855-1200 (about 55% of the frame) at lum_median 10-10.5; no counter, lantern face or amber band is visible.

change.to: Pull back toward the bar by about 3-4 m (x about 7.5-8.0) at seated or bar-stool eye level 1.25-1.35 m, offset about 0.6 m to one side, lens 28-35 mm, f/2.8, verticals true. Include the edge of the quartzite counter with a glass in the near foreground, the full slotted oak face of the lantern, the amber band over the opening and the porch as a lit doorway with the pair and Mother framed inside it.

changes.expected: The porch becomes about 25-35% of the frame width, set inside a legible lantern face, with the bar in front. The image reads as a specific place with depth: bar, lantern, room.

changes.problem: The image is underexposed, so the frame and the speakers sit below the dim-but-readable band.

evidence.measured: Frame lum_median 11.4 (target 22-50); speakers lum_median 16.0 and 16.2 (target 45 or more); 91.7% of pixels below 40.

change.to: 4.0 (about +0.8 stop), with highlights protected by the AgX look 'Medium Contrast' instead of 'Medium High Contrast'

changes.expected: The frame median rises to about 25-30; shadows hold oak grain and terrazzo; lamps and acrylic edges stay below clipping.

changes.problem: A strong red-orange cast turns every neutral surface into the same saturated red, so the speaker's Ember is not the only colour and the oak, plaster and terrazzo do not read.

evidence.measured: Median RGB 47/19/9 in the room and 26/8/2 for the frame; the blue channel is nearly empty.

change.to: 2750 K / +1.0 (neutralise the 2600-2700 K practicals to a warm, not orange, white)

changes.expected: Oak reads honey-brown, plaster reads warm grey, terrazzo reads as chips; the Ember pair separates from the room as the only saturated red.

changes.problem: The Tropos pair is lit from inside more than from outside, so the covers read as glowing red signage with clipped edges rather than thick cast acrylic.

evidence.measured: lum_median 16 with p95 151; the cover edge strip [340,420,352,520] clips 4.3% at r 117 / g 7 / b 2.

change.setting: inside the lantern: the pair spots
change.to: 2 x 90 W, 30 deg, 2700 K, aimed about 30 deg off-axis from above and in front so the light rakes the cover faces and catches the polished edges as thin highlights; add a small dim rim (area about 0.05 W/m2) behind each cabinet to separate it from the slats

changes.expected: The cabinets read as solid volumes with lit faces and bright thin edges; the speaker region median is 45 or more without clipping.

changes.problem: Mother's spot misses her and draws a hard ellipse on the empty floor, while her plinth sits in the dark.

evidence.measured: Floor pool lum_median 49 / p95 131; plinth [500,535,620,590] lum_median 10.5.

change.setting: inside the lantern: Mother EARF spot
change.to: 60 W, 24 deg, 2700 K with a soft edge (spot blend 0.6), re-aimed at her centre and the top of her plinth so the pool falls on the plinth and fades onto the floor

changes.expected: The plinth's terrazzo shows, the floor pool softens and merges, and Mother sits in light rather than above a stage mark.

changes.problem: The people are smooth capsule mannequins without real motion blur; at a glance they read as placeholders.

evidence.measured: Seen at 3x: blob head, torso and arms with uniform matte dark shading and no edge blur.

change.to: Scanned or clothed human assets (one at the bar in the foreground, one or two in the room), each moving (turning, reaching for a glass) so shutter 1.0 produces visible blur; otherwise remove them and leave signs of life instead (a coat on a chair, a glass, a record out of its sleeve).

changes.expected: The figures read as people in a real room, or are gone with the room still feeling occupied.

changes.problem: Below a single scallop the slatted back wall and the floor fall into flat darkness, so there are no pools of light between the dark areas and the materials do not show.

change.setting: inside the lantern: fill and trap; haze

changes.expected: The lower wall and floor hold detail at lum 20-30, the slats show grain, and faint haze makes the spots legible as pools.

changes.problem: The room is a showroom: empty floor, crude chairs and no sign of use.

evidence.measured: No props are visible; the floor and chairs are flat and dark.

change.to: Two glasses with a little liquid on the counter in the foreground and one on the floor by a chair, a record sleeve leaning on Mother's plinth, a coat over one chair back

changes.expected: Small highlights on glass and the paper of the sleeve give life and scale.

out_of_scope.request: Reduce or remove Mother EARF's blue, green and yellow rings, which break the one-colour rule next to the Ember pair.
out_of_scope.why: Mother EARF is a placed EARF product and fixed by the card. The owner should decide whether the frame's colour rule allows her, or whether her rings can be dimmed by light level only.

out_of_scope.request: Thicker, visibly polished edges on the Tropos covers.
out_of_scope.why: That is the speaker's geometry and finish, which the card fixes. Only lighting (c4) is prescribed.

out_of_scope.request: Detail the porch jambs (door leaves, hardware, a reveal).
out_of_scope.why: The porch is architecture as drawn. Moving the camera (c1) makes the jambs a smaller part of the frame instead.
